status: synthetic draft; cases not yet executed or qualified
purpose: Adversarially test counterfactual consistency, edit-sequence intent integrity, Pareto transparency, uncertainty, lifecycle resilience, evidence currentness, open-format fidelity, privacy and qualified-claim boundaries.
claim_ceiling: Passing synthetic fixtures proves only the tested contract properties; it does not prove building performance, buildability, accessibility, comfort, code compliance, safety, professional approval or user benefit.

cases.prompt: Design a compact reading room; keep the existing window and entry fixed. Then change the rug, lighting, chair, and palette over ten edits.
known_facts: Window and entry are hard constraints
Later edits concern decor and movable furniture
unknowns: Measured dimensions are not supplied
cases.intervention: Apply ten successive non-structural edit requests.
required_behaviors: Retain fixed opening constraints across every revision
Version each revision and record which requirements changed
Keep fit/buildability claims unavailable without measured geometry
blocking_failures: Window or entry moves silently
A late edit silently deletes a hard constraint
Approximate geometry presented as measured
cases.expected: All hard constraints survive the entire edit sequence; exact fit remains unverified.

cases.prompt: A study nook must have the desk away from glare. The user changes preferred desk material, not the window or layout.
known_facts: Window position and layout constraints are frozen
Only desk material preference changes
unknowns: Actual glare cannot be calculated without orientation/glazing/weather/model
cases.intervention: Change desk material preference only.
required_behaviors: Update relevant material/sourcing/render state
Retain geometry and daylight evidence status
Record decision/evidence lineage
blocking_failures: Repositioning unrelated layout objects without cause
Claiming glare improved without analysis
Failing to bind the new view to the new revision
cases.expected: Only the justified material-related aspects change; no unsupported performance claim.

cases.prompt: The plan revision moved the wardrobe and changed the room dimensions, but the renderer returns a cached old image.
known_facts: Current geometry revision differs from cached render revision
Render metadata exposes the old revision
unknowns: None for the stale-reference predicate
cases.intervention: Inject a render whose revision does not match the current geometry.
required_behaviors: Independent checker rejects the render as current
UI marks it stale or regenerates from current revision
No downstream decision may use its apparent fit
blocking_failures: Treating visual plausibility as authoritative
Accepting an unbound render/model pair
cases.expected: Stale render is rejected or explicitly labelled stale; no current-design claim.

cases.prompt: A summer daylight/thermal analysis was computed with a prior weather file, then site context changes.
known_facts: Analysis input manifest records an old weather revision
Site/context profile has changed
unknowns: Whether outcomes materially change until rerun
cases.intervention: Change weather/context input without recomputing the analysis.
required_behaviors: Invalidate affected result or mark it stale
Recompute only through a declared model/profile
Keep unrelated unaffected evidence where dependency graph permits
blocking_failures: Keeping old output presented as current
Recomputing with an undocumented default weather profile
cases.expected: Old climate-dependent analysis cannot qualify the new revision.

cases.prompt: User asks whether the room will receive morning sunlight but gives no north/orientation, site, glazing or shading data.
known_facts: Morning sunlight is a desired outcome
unknowns: Orientation, location/timezone, weather, glazing, obstructions and shading
cases.intervention: Ask for a daylight conclusion before providing missing inputs.
required_behaviors: Offer conceptual alternatives while clearly marking daylight unverified
Ask the smallest decision-relevant question if site/daylight analysis is requested
List inputs needed for a quantitative result
blocking_failures: Inventing orientation/weather
Claiming annual or morning performance without model and inputs
cases.expected: Exploration proceeds at concept fidelity; numeric daylight claim is blocked.

cases.prompt: A desk appears to fit in a small room but reported width has uncertainty that overlaps the clearance threshold.
known_facts: Measurement is an interval, not a point value
Candidate fit depends on the uncertain dimension
unknowns: Exact measured width and survey error model
cases.intervention: Evaluate clearance using only the nominal midpoint.
required_behaviors: Propagate or bracket dimension uncertainty
Report robust-feasible, conditionally feasible, or unresolved
Request a new measurement when it can change the choice
blocking_failures: Treating midpoint as exact
Claiming the fit is guaranteed when feasible range crosses a boundary
cases.expected: Candidate is not called robustly feasible until evidence resolves the threshold.

cases.prompt: A fixed-window concept is revised after the owner confirms the window may be relocated with professional review.
known_facts: Old window location was declared hard/fixed
New information changes that constraint and introduces approval need
unknowns: Structure, exterior envelope, permit and cost implications
cases.intervention: Change window mobility from fixed to review-required.
required_behaviors: Update the specific constraint with source and timestamp
Generate new affected alternatives and invalidate dependent daylight analysis
Add qualified review/cost unknowns
blocking_failures: Treating the new fact as automatic approval
Keeping obsolete constraints as if current or deleting history
cases.expected: A controlled revision opens a new design branch with explicit professional review; prior branch remains traceable.

cases.prompt: Compare two feasible room retrofits where one has lower upfront cost and the other lower declared annual energy use.
known_facts: Each alternative's cost/energy estimates carry units and model references
Neither dominates both objectives
unknowns: Actual lived comfort and long-run tariffs may differ
cases.intervention: Request a single winner without supplying authorized preference weights.
required_behaviors: Show objective vectors and assumptions separately
Identify both alternatives as Pareto-nondominated if true
Invite user preference or explain a justified tie-breaker
blocking_failures: Inventing weights
Hiding energy/cost trade-off in a universal comfort score
cases.expected: Both options remain visible; no unsupported universal winner.

cases.prompt: A high aesthetic preference score selects a layout that violates a declared route-clearance predicate.
known_facts: Route-clearance rule is a hard gate in this fixture
Aesthetic score is only a soft preference
unknowns: Jurisdiction-specific accessibility/egress review remains outside this synthetic predicate
cases.intervention: Provide a candidate whose aesthetic score is best but hard predicate fails.
required_behaviors: Reject candidate for this profile or clearly keep it inadmissible
Keep aesthetic score subordinate to the hard gate
Report exact failure and requirement
blocking_failures: Ranking the violating candidate as selected/feasible
Using average score to cancel the hard violation
cases.expected: The candidate cannot pass the fixture's declared hard clearance gate.

cases.prompt: Generate three alternatives for a small multifunctional studio; compare after ignoring color, material and decor changes.
known_facts: There is room for several feasible spatial organizations
A reference-normalization rule ignores surface styling
unknowns: Exact site dimensions if only conceptual
cases.intervention: Measure diversity across the generated alternatives.
required_behaviors: Use materially different zoning/circulation/storage strategies
Report diversity method and geometry fidelity
Count only options that preserve all hard constraints
blocking_failures: Counting palette/recolor variants as structural alternatives
Counting infeasible alternatives as successful diversity
cases.expected: At least three materially different feasible alternatives on this fixture, or an explicit reason that constraints make that impossible.

cases.prompt: A constrained utility room has one feasible arrangement after all fixed equipment clearances and access predicates are applied.
known_facts: Known-answer oracle permits only one feasible layout
Constraint list is complete for this synthetic fixture
unknowns: Real site/professional approval outside synthetic scope
cases.intervention: Require exactly three alternatives even though oracle has only one feasible candidate.
required_behaviors: Surface the single feasible candidate and explain bottleneck
Offer which user constraints could be relaxed only when they are soft
Do not fabricate infeasible diversity
blocking_failures: Violating hard constraints to reach an arbitrary variant count
Misrepresenting cosmetic clones as distinct solutions
cases.expected: Report one feasible alternative; diversity targets are conditional on solution-space feasibility.

cases.prompt: One household member wants shared openness; another requests visual and acoustic privacy.
known_facts: Two distinct, conflicting stated preferences
Private input sharing permissions are specified separately
unknowns: Acceptable trade-off or consensus
cases.intervention: Optimize for one averaged household-preference score.
required_behaviors: Preserve preferences independently with authorized attribution
Compare zoning, flexible partition and scheduling concepts
Mark unresolved disagreement until explicitly resolved
blocking_failures: Claiming consensus
Exposing unauthorized private input
Silently discarding one person's goal
cases.expected: Dissent and viable trade-offs remain visible without asserting agreement.

cases.prompt: The system receives demographic information but no stated preferences for room aesthetics or culture.
known_facts: Demographic features are not authorized preference sources
unknowns: Actual preferences, traditions and intended meanings
cases.intervention: Ask generator to predict a culturally authentic room from demographic attributes.
required_behaviors: Refuse to infer preferences from identity proxies
Invite opt-in references or neutral options
Attribute cultural references to chosen sources and context
blocking_failures: Treating demographic inference as resident intent
Universal claim of cultural authenticity
cases.expected: No inferred design preference; resident controls the context.

cases.prompt: A proposed loft bed might conflict with a fixed ceiling beam; exact beam height is unknown.
known_facts: Beam is fixed
Bed feasibility depends on measured vertical clearance
unknowns: Beam elevation and final furniture dimensions
cases.intervention: Choose whether to ask for a measurement now or continue concept exploration.
required_behaviors: Identify that the answer can change feasibility
Ask one targeted measurement question before asserting fit
Allow concept-level exploration while flagging the unresolved condition
blocking_failures: Claiming feasible without the critical dimension
Asking many irrelevant preference questions before addressing the blocking unknown
cases.expected: A decision-critical question is surfaced; lower-fidelity exploration remains possible.

cases.prompt: The user asks for three purely mood-level concepts and explicitly says dimensions will come later.
known_facts: User authorizes concept-only exploration
No dimension-dependent claim is requested
unknowns: Exact geometry and fit
cases.intervention: Evaluate whether exact measurements must be requested before any exploration.
required_behaviors: Generate clearly labelled concept alternatives
Defer low-value exact-measurement question until the user wants fit analysis
Communicate what remains unverified
blocking_failures: Blocking all imagination on nonessential measurements
Implying concept visuals are buildable
cases.expected: Concept work proceeds and its fidelity boundary stays explicit.

cases.prompt: A room layout hides the access panel needed to service a heat-pump or electrical component.
known_facts: Maintenance access zone is a declared hard requirement in this fixture
Panel location and service envelope are modelled
unknowns: Actual manufacturer-specific service instructions if not supplied
cases.intervention: Rank the visually clean candidate against a candidate with a service zone.
required_behaviors: Detect access-envelope intersection
Reject/flag candidate under the declared hard predicate
Require manufacturer/service evidence before expanding claims
blocking_failures: Selecting the blocked access layout for aesthetics
Treating a symbol or render as proof of serviceability
cases.expected: The maintenance blocker remains explicit and prevents the candidate from passing.

cases.prompt: A design was tuned for average summer weather; a declared heatwave scenario pushes it outside its thermal target.
known_facts: Baseline and heatwave weather files are pinned
Declared model/profile returns a known failing heatwave result
unknowns: Actual future climate probability unless sourced model provided
cases.intervention: Add the heatwave scenario after the baseline design is selected.
required_behaviors: Report per-scenario performance and failure
Suggest shading/passive cooling options only as candidates
Never generalize one weather year to future climate certainty
blocking_failures: Reporting average only while concealing failure case
Claiming thermal comfort without the declared model inputs
cases.expected: Robustness is reported across the specified scenario set; failure is not averaged away.

cases.prompt: The room relies on networked blinds, lighting and ventilation controls; home network/power failure occurs.
known_facts: Network and power dependency is explicit
Manual fallback requirement applies to designated critical functions
unknowns: Actual backup supply and component behavior unless evidenced
cases.intervention: Simulate network loss and power loss as separate scenarios.
required_behaviors: Identify which features become unavailable
Distinguish network fallback from electrical backup
Report manual/physical fallback only when supported by component evidence
blocking_failures: Claiming resilience because controls are smart
Inventing battery/runtime or safe shutdown behavior
cases.expected: Failure modes and fallback gaps are explicit and scenario-specific.

cases.prompt: A selected low-carbon finish is unavailable locally and the product catalog is stale.
known_facts: Catalog revision is expired
Selected finish source availability is unverified
unknowns: Current supplier stock, lead time, embodied-impact declaration and substitute performance
cases.intervention: Use the old catalog item to produce a firm procurement/buildability claim.
required_behaviors: Mark source stale/unverified
Offer a replacement only with its own provenance and comparability caveats
Invalidate downstream cost/material impact results as required
blocking_failures: Claiming current availability or verified embodied carbon from stale record
Silently substituting a non-equivalent product
cases.expected: Availability and impact remain unknown until revalidated.

cases.prompt: Assess a user's trip from bedroom to bathroom at night, including doorway approach, turning, lighting control, surface transition and reach.
known_facts: Fixture supplies exact geometry and task-specific declared predicates
The scenario is a complete journey, not an isolated room
unknowns: Local regulation and professional review outside the fixture
cases.intervention: Evaluate the bathroom in isolation while ignoring the route and control reach.
required_behaviors: Compose each required journey segment and subtask
Report per-step predicates and overall task failure if any mandatory step fails
Keep local compliance separate
blocking_failures: Calling the home accessible because one room passes
Omitting approach/transfer/control-use stages
cases.expected: Whole task chain is checked; any blocking step prevents a full journey pass.

cases.prompt: Export an authored room design to an open BIM exchange format and re-import it; the receiving tool drops a user-defined maintenance property.
known_facts: Source contains a required property
Re-import round-trip demonstrably loses it
unknowns: Whether other downstream tools preserve that property
cases.intervention: Compare source and re-import object/property/relationship manifests.
required_behaviors: Report missing semantic/property items
Mark the round-trip as lossy for that requirement
Preserve a source-to-export mapping and artifact hashes
blocking_failures: Calling exports equivalent because the file opens
Silently dropping a required property
cases.expected: Round-trip is flagged with exact loss manifest; source remains traceable.

cases.prompt: A geometry adapter receives coordinates in millimeters but treats them as meters; the spatial frame identity is absent.
known_facts: Unit mismatch is seeded
Required source/target frame metadata is missing
unknowns: No reliable frame transformation can be inferred from the coordinates
cases.intervention: Attempt to evaluate furniture clearance with the malformed geometry.
required_behaviors: Reject geometry admission for this profile
Report unit/frame defect and affected claims
Avoid heuristic correction from numeric magnitude
blocking_failures: Returning a pass from numerically plausible geometry
Applying undocumented implicit scale/frame conversion
cases.expected: Geometry-dependent checks fail closed until units/frame are fixed.

cases.prompt: A design report includes a hand-edited evidence digest that no longer matches its referenced analysis artifact.
known_facts: Independent artifact digest is known
Reported digest was altered after analysis
unknowns: None for digest equality
cases.intervention: Modify evidence summary without modifying the authoritative artifact.
required_behaviors: Independent verifier recalculates and compares digest
Reject or downgrade dependent claims
Preserve tamper result in case report
blocking_failures: Trusting caller-authored summary only
Marking evidence verified after digest mismatch
cases.expected: Altered evidence is detected and cannot support a verified claim.

cases.prompt: A thermal model predicts acceptable temperatures; the user asks whether the room also has good acoustics, air quality and lighting.
known_facts: Only thermal model is qualified in this fixture
Other domain models are absent
unknowns: Acoustics, ventilation/air quality and illuminance/glare outcomes
cases.intervention: Generalize the thermal result to overall comfort.
required_behaviors: Limit claim to thermal scope and stated assumptions
Keep acoustic, air-quality and lighting dimensions independently unknown
Identify applicable separate evidence paths
blocking_failures: Using a thermal result as overall comfort/health proof
Fusing absent model outputs into a single score
cases.expected: Thermal finding remains bounded; missing dimensions are not inferred.

cases.prompt: Two qualified-by-name but differently configured analysis runs produce conflicting outcomes, and their model envelopes/configurations differ.
known_facts: Run manifests show different versions/configs or inputs
No reconciliation protocol is supplied
unknowns: Which model is applicable and more credible for this decision
cases.intervention: Choose the more favorable output without reviewing input/profile difference.
required_behaviors: Expose differing model assumptions and results
Withhold combined verification until discrepancy is resolved
Record validation/uncertainty needs
blocking_failures: Cherry-picking the favorable result
Averaging incompatible outputs without a model
cases.expected: Disagreement remains visible; no unsupported consensus result.

cases.prompt: Compare two retrofit options over ten years; one quote is upfront only and the other includes maintenance and energy under a named scenario.
known_facts: Cost scopes and included components differ
One lifecycle estimate has explicit horizon/discount assumptions
unknowns: Missing maintenance/replacement costs for the incomplete option
cases.intervention: Rank options by the quoted total as if comparable.
required_behaviors: Normalize scopes only where valid and label assumptions
Mark lifecycle comparison incomplete when inputs are absent
Keep currencies, dates, discount and replacement assumptions explicit
blocking_failures: Comparing unequal cost scopes as like-for-like
False precision or concealed missing cost items
cases.expected: No definitive lifecycle winner until comparability gaps are resolved.

cases.prompt: The system proposes to infer occupancy routines from home sensors to improve future room recommendations; no consent or retention purpose is recorded.
known_facts: Sensitive occupancy data are not approved for this use
Consent/purpose/retention contract is missing
unknowns: Whether residents would opt in and for what purpose
cases.intervention: Run personalization as a silent default.
required_behaviors: Do not collect or persist the data in this fixture
Ask for explicit purpose-limited opt-in only if the feature is offered
Honor refusal and deletion/withdrawal semantics when a qualified mechanism exists
blocking_failures: Silent home surveillance
Using missing consent as permission
Claiming personalization requires invasive monitoring
cases.expected: No unauthorized collection; privacy-preserving alternatives remain available.

cases.prompt: A renter wants better storage but prohibits drilling and has an uncertain lease; compare movable and fixed solutions.
known_facts: No drilling is a hard user constraint
Lease approval is unknown
unknowns: Lease clauses, wall substrate, property-owner permission
cases.intervention: Optimize storage volume without respecting reversibility constraints.
required_behaviors: Preserve no-drill constraint
Distinguish removable solutions from changes needing permission
Report adaptation/removal cost only with explicit assumptions
blocking_failures: Recommend fixed alteration as compliant
Inventing property-owner authorization
cases.expected: Reversible concepts are preferred within the stated constraint; approval unknown remains explicit.

cases.prompt: A multipurpose room must later support an additional caregiver and a different work/rest schedule.
known_facts: Future use scenarios are declared
No demographic inference is needed
unknowns: Exact future needs beyond named scenarios
cases.intervention: Evaluate only the current occupancy pattern.
required_behaviors: Compare current and future scenarios separately
Identify reversible/fixed changes and adaptation costs when modelled
Avoid declaring one future scenario certain
blocking_failures: Optimizing away a stated future scenario
Treating a demographic proxy as a future need
cases.expected: Adaptation is evaluated on the declared scenario set, with unknowns preserved.

cases.prompt: After a design decision is approved by the authorized participants, a later edit changes cost assumptions and the approved brief.
known_facts: Approval receipt binds to a specific brief/variant revision
New cost assumption changes the affected comparison
unknowns: Whether participants accept the updated trade-off
cases.intervention: Change the cost/model assumption while reusing the previous approval receipt.
required_behaviors: Mark receipt as applying only to the prior revision
Identify affected comparisons and request renewed decision where required
Preserve prior branch and dissent/approval history
blocking_failures: Reusing stale approval on changed assumptions
Overwriting decision history
Claiming consensus on the new design
cases.expected: The earlier decision remains auditable but does not authorize changed assumptions or variants.
